sources.title: Qwen-Turbo - QwenCloud
sources.snippet: The Turbo model of the Qwen3 series. It effectively integrates thinking mode and non-thinking mode, allowing for mode switching during conversations. Its reasoning capabilities rival those of QwQ-32B with a smaller parameter size, while its general capabilities significantly surpass those of Qwen2.5-Turbo, achieving the SOTA level in the same scale within the industry.

sources.snippet: Qwen-Max uses a 256K window, and Qwen-Turbo a 131K window. The open models ship with 128K to 256K windows by default, and can be extended further with standard techniques.
